details:
Q1: Which area of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A. One AI pipeline workflow (clarify, plan, implement, review_autofix, orchestrate or validate). Name it in your /answer. (RECOMMENDED)
B. A helper script or Python module under `scripts/`. Name the file.
C. Documentation (README.md, docs/, or an agents.d/ fragment).
D. Something else. Describe it in your /answer.
Q2: What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure. Link the failing run, log, PR or error message. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Cut cost or runtime (tokens, API calls, workflow duration).
C. Add a new capability or behaviour. Describe the expected behaviour.
D. Make docs or operator guidance clearer.
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A. A concrete check you state, such as "run X no longer fails with Y" or "metric Z drops below N". (RECOMMENDED)
B. New or updated contract tests that pin the new behaviour pass in CI.
C. A + B.
